edits.current: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods); AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase.
edits.proposed: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).

edits.current: From the health period of August 2025: lectiva-phase apprentices under Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21; health and occupational risk only, IBC 1 SMMLV (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026)). The annex names no code for the productive phase.
edits.proposed: From the health period of August 2025: lectiva-phase apprentices under Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21; health and occupational risk only, IBC 1 SMMLV (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026)). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025 the annex names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).
